# ShrinkIt

> ShrinkIt is a free image resizer, compressor and converter created by Dusrel. It runs entirely on the user's own device — as a website, an Android app, a Windows app and a Chrome extension — so images are never uploaded to a server. No sign-up, no watermarks, no premium tier: every feature, including batch processing, is free.

ShrinkIt resizes images by pixels, percentage, centimetres or inches (aspect ratio locked or free; stretch, crop and fit modes), compresses to a chosen quality or to an exact target file size, and converts between JPG, PNG, GIF and WebP. It opens JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP, BMP, AVIF and iPhone HEIC/HEIF files. All processing happens locally on the device: there is no upload step and no server ever receives, stores or sees the images. Every output file is stripped of all metadata — EXIF, GPS location and camera details. The website uses Cloudflare Web Analytics only for aggregate, cookie-free visit statistics (page views and load speeds) that identify no visitor; the apps and extension use no analytics at all.

## Tools

- [Image Resizer](https://shrinkit.dusrel.com/resize/): Resize an image by pixels, percent, cm or inches, change format and quality, and download it — free, with no upload.
- [Compress Image to 50KB](https://shrinkit.dusrel.com/tools/compress-to-50kb/): Compress a photo to 50 KB or under, the size limit used by exam and recruitment portals such as UPSC, SSC and IBPS.
- [Compress Image to 20KB — Signature to 20KB](https://shrinkit.dusrel.com/tools/compress-to-20kb/): Compress a signature or photo to 20 KB or under, with a black-and-white mode for signature scans.
- [Passport Photo Maker](https://shrinkit.dusrel.com/tools/passport-photo-maker/): Make passport-size photos with guided cropping and standard dimensions.
- [Social Media Resizer](https://shrinkit.dusrel.com/tools/social-media-resizer/): Resize images to the exact sizes used by social platforms, with ready-made presets.
- [Compare Images](https://shrinkit.dusrel.com/tools/compare-images/): Compare an image before and after compression side by side to check quality.
- [All Free Tools](https://shrinkit.dusrel.com/tools/): The full list of ShrinkIt tools.
